closing_information.description: The Closing Information block in the page 1 header.

property_address.description: Property address, joined into one line.

sale_price.description: Sale price of the property, in dollars.

transaction_information.description: The Transaction Information block in the page 1 header.

borrowers.description: Borrower name or names, as printed.

sellers.description: Seller name or names, as printed.

loan_information.description: The Loan Information block in the page 1 header.

purpose.description: Loan purpose, e.g. Purchase or Refinance.

loan_terms.description: The Loan Terms table on page 1.

interest_rate_percent.description: Interest rate, as a percentage, e.g. 3.875.

monthly_principal_and_interest.description: Monthly principal and interest payment, in dollars.

has_prepayment_penalty.description: Whether the loan has a prepayment penalty (YES/NO).

prepayment_penalty_max.description: Maximum prepayment penalty, in dollars, if one applies.

has_balloon_payment.description: Whether the loan has a balloon payment (YES/NO).

projected_payments.description: One entry per column of the Projected Payments table on page 1.

mortgage_insurance.description: Mortgage insurance, in dollars; 0 when shown as a dash.

estimated_total_monthly_payment.description: Estimated total monthly payment, in dollars.

estimated_taxes_insurance_assessments_mo.description: Estimated taxes, insurance and assessments per month, in dollars.

costs_at_closing.description: The Costs at Closing table on page 1.

closing_cost_details.description: Section totals from Closing Cost Details on page 2, borrower-paid.

origination_charges.description: A. Origination Charges total, in dollars.

services_did_not_shop_for.description: B. Services Borrower Did Not Shop For total, in dollars.

services_did_shop_for.description: C. Services Borrower Did Shop For total, in dollars.

total_loan_costs.description: D. Total Loan Costs (Borrower-Paid), in dollars.

total_other_costs.description: I. Total Other Costs (Borrower-Paid), in dollars.

lender_credits.description: Lender credits, in dollars, as a positive number; null when the line is blank.

total_closing_costs.description: J. Total Closing Costs (Borrower-Paid), in dollars.

borrower_transaction.description: Borrower's Transaction in the Summaries of Transactions on page 3.

total_due_from_borrower.description: K. Due from Borrower at Closing, in dollars.

total_paid_by_or_on_behalf_of_borrower.description: L. Paid Already by or on Behalf of Borrower at Closing, in dollars.

seller_transaction.description: Seller's Transaction in the Summaries of Transactions on page 3.

total_due_to_seller.description: M. Due to Seller at Closing, in dollars.

total_due_from_seller.description: N. Due from Seller at Closing, in dollars.

cash_to_seller.description: Cash to (or from) seller in the seller's calculation, in dollars.

has_escrow_account.description: Whether the loan will have an escrow account.

escrowed_property_costs_year_1.description: Escrowed property costs over year 1, in dollars.

grace_period_days.description: Days late before a fee is charged.

late_fee_percent.description: Late fee as a percentage of the monthly principal and interest payment.

apr_percent.description: Annual Percentage Rate, as a percentage.

total_interest_percentage.description: Total Interest Percentage (TIP), as a percentage.

lender_contact.description: The Lender column of Contact Information on page 5.
